## Checklist

- [ ] One ticket; spec IDs referenced (FR-xx, CT-xx, AT-xx)

- [ ] SPEC.md / CONTEXT.md updated if behavior, contracts, states, or terms changed

- [ ] Board content still treated as untrusted data (no prompt/tool/policy path)

- [ ] Cost impact noted if it adds Cloudflare usage (see docs/COSTS.md)
- [ ] Security impact described (or "none")
